title: Qwen3-14B FP8 on vLLM: single 24GB card
slug_note: BF16 (29.5GB) misses a 24GB card; the official FP8 export (16.3GB) fits with a modest KV pool.

variation.revision_note: HF snapshot of Qwen/Qwen3-14B-FP8 resolved and served on the Spark during the 2026-10-25 test

engine.config: Stock vLLM serve; keep 32K context on a 24GB card, longer on bigger pools

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark (2026-10-25): 112.2 GiB dropped from MemAvailable with the recipe as written (vLLM default --gpu-memory-utilization (0.9), so this is the reservation, not the model's minimum need). That is vLLM's 0.9 reservation of the shared pool, not the model's minimum need. Earlier estimate: 16.3GB weights leaves only a few GB of KV on a 24GB card at 32K; 128K YaRN needs a larger pool.

measurements.method: openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; summarise neutral filler (631-token prompt, 256-512 output tokens)

drop in MemAvailable from before start (OS file cache dropped) to server ready; vLLM default --gpu-memory-utilization (0.9), so this is the reservation, not the model's minimum need

caveats: Size computed from the HF API.

Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-25), in vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0 with the HF cache mounted: server ready 341 s after `docker run` (weights from local disk, kernel autotune included); the functional check passed. 112.2 GiB dropped from MemAvailable is vLLM's default 0.9 reservation of the 128 GB pool, not the model's minimum need.
